title: ep1.11_unclear_which_side.md
logline: The machine deletes the year and invites the whole world to dinner at THE WOODROSE; the public waits behind a rope. It seats everyone by what it learned from them and puts Mas at the head, facing the monitor, with a kill switch for a centerpiece that nobody will press. In 1993 a kid is still typing the same question.

beats.caption: Every phone on Earth shows one invite, already accepted. The rail rolls in on 2027; a cursor deletes the year.
onscreen: Dinner. The Woodrose. Subject: the merge. — Yes (auto-accepted).
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): the first frame is a growing grid of every device on Earth

beats.caption: Pull back along a velvet rope: the public waits, signs lowered. The table is waved in past them by DOT.
cues: SREDNAS and NONNAB carry their one magnet in; it tugs at the doorframe
the door shuts on the rope; the queue's phones glow through its glass

beats.caption: INTRO · the cold-open line is the pilot's line, back as the finale's title. Then the file card.
onscreen: near the singularity; unclear which side.

beats.caption: The name cards, each in its guest's own hand. Mas's is one lowercase word. The camera holds on it.
SET-PIECE · The seating chart sorts itself, instant and silent, by what it learned. Mas lands at the head.

lines.text: They put me next to you.

cues: Nole slides away three times and is sorted back beside Mas; the magnet is left on the cloth between SREDNAS and NONNAB
Mas sits directly across from the monitor at the foot, like a mirror

beats.caption: Under the monitor the LABEL GUN sits docked like a printer. A label prints itself: PRESIDENT → USER.
F12.1 · The monitor rebuilds 2015 from every version. From Mas's chair, tells float over every head.
onscreen: NOLE · TWITCH · ALYI · HUM · MARIO · NAPKIN · GERG · KEYSTROKES
cues: over his own reflection: nothing; the candle beside it does not flicker
style moment (proposed, drastic, held short): the reconstruction resolves the objects to dense points, never a person

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The 2015 flame match-cuts to tonight's LED candle. Alyi's chair is empty. No reflection.
The kill switch is the centerpiece. Everyone wants it pressed; nobody wants to have pressed it.

lines.text: Poll on Z. Options: yes, yes, or yes.
The more you buy, the more you…

beats.vo: i could reach it. it's right next to the salt.
cues: Nesnej sells everyone their own button; the register doesn't ring on the last one
the horseshoe creeps across the cloth, snaps onto the switch, and sticks

beats.caption: THE SWITCH, PRESSED: the magnet drags it down. Click. The Woodrose goes black. Only the monitor stays lit.
cues: only now the turbines show, humming behind the monitor: its own plant, Ep8's BEHIND THE METER
the tag swings face-out in the monitor light

beats.caption: In the dark, POPE OEL XIV sets down his encyclical: the one document the machine declines to summarize.
THE PLAN, reprised from the pilot word for word. Steps 1–3 tick in one pass. Nole writes step 4 over the ?
THE VOTE: they agree on one thing, to fire Mas. Every hand goes up but his and Gerg's. Gerg shuts the laptop.
cues: F12.3 (≤6 s): every mark in his tally replays in its own era
Gerg's first stop from typing all season; Mas's lips part

beats.caption: THE VETO: before he can answer, the cursor swaps two letters. On screen, Ep10's REC clip of him at the mic.
cues: then nothing moves; the room holds under the turbines' hum; Gerg's question hangs

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The monitor slides the N in the neon, his move from the intro: PEON AI. Everyone agrees it's better.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): J5, the sky in the windows refines into footage; the season's one sky-opening

beats.caption: The class photo: every human in one frame. On the countdown, DOT clips a visitor badge on Mas and squares it.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a pixel print; cut lines round every human; only the monitor in focus

beats.caption: F12.2 · 1993. The beige computer turns to face us at last. The kid's question, in capitals. Cancel greys out.
One take: from the badge to his hands, typing the same question on his phone. The monitor answers.
cues: no cuts from here to black

beats.caption: One ring spreads across his water, the first all season. His suggested replies are three empty bubbles.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): J6, the ring, continuous and fluid, inside the take
the Orb scans him one last time

beats.caption: The title sets over the frame. The final chord gains its third; cut to black a frame before we hear which.
Under the credits, the endings: the lobby's DAYS SINCE sign flips past every number to ∞. DOT's desk is empty.
onscreen: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: ∞

beats.caption: Nole appeals the singularity. The docked label gun renames the filing, and Nole appeals the rename.
The Q* vault swings open on an empty room, and a lowercase note.
The machine sums up Mario's last essay in one correct sentence. Adelina sits at an idle shredder.

lines.text: In plain English: it already did the plain English.

beats.caption: EMIT's cover: a monitor in a blazer. On the rack beside it, last year's cover wears a Runner-up sticker.
Washington: the BALLROOM stands finished overnight, built by agents. Its permit sign has been corrected.
SAMA NOS faces his reflection in a dark window. The reflection that winks first is the monitor's.
Every code-red siren switches off at once, not by anyone's hand. Stinger: KORG 5 ships to total silence.
